scope.description: Installed Zed 10x external-agent and environment-bearing remote execution journeys across Mac-local and Mac-to-Intrepid projects

nativeCommands: rustup run 1.95.0-aarch64-apple-darwin cargo test -p project remote_external_agent
rustup run 1.95.0-aarch64-apple-darwin cargo test -p remote_server remote_external_agent

3-implementation.redEvidence: The prior installed app exposed a resolved remote environment in the local SSH argv; generic builders accepted private values, PTY startup had no private readiness channel, and the prior ACP-only plan omitted sibling consumers.
3-implementation.greenEvidence: All 19 rows map to deterministic tests or executable installed UAT. Private netstring framing, POSIX SSH builders, real PTY behavior, terminal ordering, MCP/DAP ordering, the full consumer inventory, capability mismatch, unsupported backends, content-free receipts, package identity, exhaustive route coverage, and installed picker launch classes now have named executable coverage. The full remote_server target set found and closed a stale capability assertion plus an under-budgeted cold-start harness timeout.

4-execution.summary: Seventeen rows retain valid direct evidence. ACP-JOURNEY-002 is reopened because its representative-route evidence did not cover the independently selectable 14-entry Mac and 18-entry Intrepid picker inventories. ACP-ASSEMBLED-019 prevents the direct protocol matrix from impersonating the installed Zed picker/session journey. The matrix, execution-class inventory and registry/custom resolver are deterministic-green; exact route and assembled-app host runs remain pending.

5-analysis.summary: Prior analysis is retained as historical evidence. Final analysis must bind the exact tested revision and load-bearing picker inventory after every advertised Mac-local and Intrepid entry has route-level project evidence and every production launch class has installed-app picker/session evidence.

6-tracking.reason: Tracking and production disposition follow the reopened installed picker-matrix UAT and exact-candidate review.
